description: This script generates and manages x86 kernel page tables, including mapping memory regions, setting permissions, and outputting binary page table data for early boot configuration.

classes.name: MMUTable
classes.description: Represents a page table at any level, providing methods for mapping and permissions.

classes.name: Pml4
classes.description: Page Map Level 4 for IA-32e paging mode.

classes.name: Pdpt
classes.description: Page Directory Pointer Table for IA-32e.

classes.name: PdptPAE
classes.description: Page Directory Pointer Table for PAE mode.

classes.name: PdXd
classes.description: Page Directory for PAE or IA-32e modes.

classes.name: PtXd
classes.description: Page Table for PAE or IA-32e modes.

classes.name: PtableSet
classes.description: Represents a complete set of page tables for a specific paging mode.

classes.name: Ptables32bit
classes.description: Paging mode class for 32-bit page tables.

classes.name: PtablesPAE
classes.description: Paging mode class for PAE page tables.

classes.name: PtablesIA32e
classes.description: Paging mode class for IA-32e page tables.

methods.name: bit
methods.description: Returns a value with a 1 shifted left by the given position.

methods.name: dump_flags
methods.description: Converts page table flags into a human-readable string.

methods.name: align_check
methods.description: Checks if base address and size are page-aligned.

methods.name: round_up
methods.description: Rounds a value up to the nearest multiple of align.

methods.name: round_down
methods.description: Rounds a value down to the nearest multiple of align.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for the script.

methods.name: get_symbols
methods.description: Extracts symbols from an ELF file.

methods.name: isdef
methods.description: Checks if a symbol is defined in the ELF symbols dictionary.

methods.name: find_symbol
methods.description: Finds a specific symbol object in an ELF file.

methods.name: map_extra_regions
methods.description: Maps additional memory regions specified via command line.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating ELF parsing, page table creation, mapping, and output.
